hero.heading: A Historic Election Is Approaching
hero.subtext: For the first time in years, Haiti has a path toward a legitimate democratic transition. Find out whether you are eligible to participate.

footer.tagline: A free civic platform for Haitians.
footer.nonpartisan: Vwa is a nonpartisan civic resource. We do not endorse any candidate or political party.

parties.metaTitle: Approved Political Groupings for Haiti's 2026 Elections
parties.metaDescription: Explore the 15 political groupings approved by the CEP and their 208 member parties, alongside the complete July 2026 party registry.
parties.heading: Political groupings approved for the 2026–2027 electoral process
parties.summary: Haiti's Conseil électoral provisoire (CEP) approved 15 political groupings made up of 208 parties. The groupings are now the primary view; the complete July party registry remains available for reference.
parties.groupingsIntro: Each grouping brings together approved political parties under a named representative. Open a grouping to see its member parties and their existing Vwa profiles.
parties.groupingSearchPlaceholder: Search by grouping, representative, party, or acronym
parties.noGroupings: No approved grouping matches your search.
parties.noProfileLink: Listed in the August source; the July source did not provide a sequence number for a profile link.
parties.partyRegistrySummary: The underlying July CEP registry contains 320 entries: 316 approved parties and 4 not approved. Parties in an approved grouping remain individually searchable here.
parties.partyRegistryNote: The July PDF omits sequence rows 174, 202, and 309. The August grouping list names three VIKTWA members not found elsewhere in that registry, but does not identify which missing sequence belongs to each name.
parties.searchPlaceholder: Search by official name or acronym
parties.noResults: No parties match your search and status filter.
parties.qualificationNote: The CEP approved 15 of 18 registered groupings under Article 129. These groupings are composed of approved parties; the CEP separately scheduled registration of higher-level regroupements for August 10–14, 2026.
parties.sourceAnomaly: The VIKTWA header says 50 parties, but its numbered list contains 52. The CEP annex totals 208 parties only when all 52 listed VIKTWA members are counted; Vwa therefore displays all 52.
parties.missingName: Source row absent — manual verification required
parties.noneFound: No platform found in the audit
parties.noPresenceFound: No official presence was found in the completed audit.
parties.methodology: Vwa verifies evidence that a party controls an online channel before labeling it official. We distinguish a substantive political platform from general political messaging and slogans. “None found” means an audit did not locate a platform; it is not proof that none exists. Pending discoveries are never shown as official links.

profile.metaDescription: Official CEP information, published digital-presence research, platforms, candidates, and sources for {party}.
profile.vwaResearchNotice: This section contains VWA research that has completed human review. CEP publications remain authoritative for electoral status.
profile.reviewPending: VWA has not yet completed its digital-presence review for this party.
profile.noPresenceFound: No verified official presence was located during the completed review. This does not prove that none exists.
profile.platformFull: Substantive political platform or program published
profile.platformNoneFound: No platform was located during the completed review. This is not proof that none exists.
profile.platformUnknown: Platform classification has not been completed.
profile.candidatesUnavailable: Candidate information for this party is not yet available from the applicable CEP publications.

snapshot.summary: A contextual view of human-reviewed official websites, social channels, and political platforms. Pending research is excluded from verified totals and links.
